name: kaspa-x402
description: Specification and reference implementation for x402 payments on Kaspa.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/covenant run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/server run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/client run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/facilitator run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/cli run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/demo-gateway run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core test && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/covenant test && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/server test && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/client test && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/facilitator test && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/cli test && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/demo-gateway test
scripts.check:browser-demo: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run build && npm run site:build && node scripts/check-browser-demo.mjs
scripts.check:demo-gateway: npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/core run build && npm --workspace @kaspa-x402/demo-gateway run build && node scripts/check-demo-gateway.mjs
scripts.validate:release: npm run build && npm test && npm run validate:schemas && npm run site:deploy:check && npm run check:browser-demo && npm run check:pnn-browser && npm run check:vendor-wasm && npm run check:demo-gateway && npm run check:covenant-fixtures && npm run validate:tx-v1-consensus && npm run proof:offline && npm run proof:live:check -- --write-report && npm run pack:public:dry-run >/tmp/kaspa-x402-pack.json && npm run check:diff
scripts.validate:release:live: npm run validate:release && npm run proof:live:check -- --live --write-report
